718: def _validate_acceptance_bindings(
719:     repo: Path,
720:     manifest: Mapping[str, Any],
721:     trusted_resolver: TrustedSessionResolver | None,
722: ) -> bool:
723:     """Validates candidate, independent-review, and owner-approval byte bindings.
724: 
725:     @param repo Resolved repository root.
726:     @param manifest Accepted gate manifest.
727:     @param trusted_resolver Trusted live provider resolver.
728:     @returns Whether acceptance was produced from the exact non-consumable candidate.
729:     """
730:     candidate_hash = manifest.get("candidate_manifest_hash")
731:     candidate = _load_bound_object(
732:         repo, manifest.get("candidate_manifest_path"), candidate_hash
733:     )
734:     review_hash = manifest.get("review_hash")
735:     review = _load_bound_object(repo, manifest.get("review_report_path"), review_hash)
736:     approval_hash = manifest.get("owner_approval_hash")
737:     approval = _load_bound_object(
738:         repo, manifest.get("owner_approval_path"), approval_hash
739:     )
740:     if candidate is None or review is None or approval is None:
741:         return False
742:     unresolved = review.get("unresolved_findings")
743:     no_blockers = isinstance(unresolved, Mapping) and all(
744:         unresolved.get(level) == [] for level in ("critical", "high", "medium")
745:     )
746:     review_provenance_valid, review_completed_ms = _validate_review_provenance(
747:         repo,
748:         review,
749:         candidate_hash=candidate_hash,
750:         candidate=candidate,
751:         gate_commit=manifest.get("gate_commit"),
752:         gate_version=manifest.get("gate_version"),
753:         trusted_resolver=trusted_resolver,
754:     )
755:     if not review_provenance_valid or review_completed_ms is None:
756:         return False
757:     owner_provenance_valid, approval_event_id = _validate_owner_provenance(
758:         repo,
759:         approval,
760:         candidate_hash=candidate_hash,
761:         review_hash=review_hash,
762:         gate_commit=manifest.get("gate_commit"),
763:         gate_version=manifest.get("gate_version"),
764:         review_completed_ms=review_completed_ms,
765:         trusted_resolver=trusted_resolver,
766:     )
767:     consumption = manifest.get("approval_consumption")
768:     candidate_review = candidate.get("independent_review")
769:     candidate_owner = candidate.get("owner_approval")
770:     replay_resistant = bool(
771:         owner_provenance_valid
772:         and isinstance(consumption, Mapping)
773:         and consumption
774:         == {
775:             "event_id": approval_event_id,
776:             "candidate_manifest_hash": candidate_hash,
777:             "review_report_hash": review_hash,
778:             "gate_commit": manifest.get("gate_commit"),
779:             "gate_version": manifest.get("gate_version"),
780:         }
781:     )
782:     return bool(
783:         candidate.get("schema_version") == SUPERVISOR_GATE_SCHEMA_VERSION
784:         and candidate.get("gate_version") == manifest.get("gate_version")
785:         and candidate.get("status") == "candidate"
786:         and candidate.get("consumable") is False
787:         and candidate.get("revoked") is False
788:         and candidate.get("accepted_manifest_published") is False
789:         and isinstance(candidate_review, Mapping)
790:         and candidate_review.get("status") == "pending"
791:         and isinstance(candidate_owner, Mapping)
792:         and candidate_owner.get("status") == "pending"
793:         and candidate.get("implementation_commit") == manifest.get("gate_commit")
794:         and candidate.get("files") == manifest.get("files")
795:         and review.get("review_status") == "pass"
796:         and review.get("revoked") is False
797:         and review.get("candidate_manifest_sha256") == candidate_hash
798:         and no_blockers
799:         and approval.get("decision") == "approve"
800:         and approval.get("revoked") is False
801:         and approval.get("candidate_manifest_hash") == candidate_hash
802:         and approval.get("review_report_hash") == review_hash
803:         and approval.get("gate_version") == manifest.get("gate_version")
804:         and approval.get("gate_commit") == manifest.get("gate_commit")
805:         and replay_resistant
806:     )
807:

809: def _validate_manifest(
810:     repo: Path, trusted_resolver: TrustedSessionResolver | None
811: ) -> tuple[Mapping[str, Any] | None, dict[str, Any] | None]:
812:     """Validates the accepted manifest and every live gate-file hash.
813: 
814:     @param repo Repository root.
815:     @param trusted_resolver Trusted live provider resolver.
816:     @returns Manifest and no blocker, or no manifest and a blocker.
817:     """
818:     path = repo / ACCEPTED_MANIFEST_PATH
819:     if not _is_regular_repo_file(repo, ACCEPTED_MANIFEST_PATH):
820:         return None, _blocked("ACCEPTED_GATE_MANIFEST_REQUIRED", path=ACCEPTED_MANIFEST_PATH)
821:     manifest = _load_object(path)
822:     if manifest is None:
823:         return None, _blocked("ACCEPTED_GATE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
824:     if manifest.get("status") != "accepted" or manifest.get("schema_version") != SUPERVISOR_GATE_SCHEMA_VERSION:
825:         return None, _blocked("ACCEPTED_GATE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
826:     if manifest.get("revoked") is not False:
827:         return None, _blocked("ACCEPTED_GATE_REVOKED")
828:     commit = manifest.get("gate_commit")
829:     files = manifest.get("files")
830:     if (
831:         not isinstance(commit, str)
832:         or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", commit) is None
833:         or not isinstance(manifest.get("gate_version"), str)
834:         or not manifest["gate_version"]
835:         or not isinstance(files, Mapping)
836:         or not files
837:         or not all(isinstance(key, str) and isinstance(value, str) for key, value in files.items())
838:         or not REQUIRED_GATE_FILES.issubset(files.keys())
839:     ):
840:         return None, _blocked("ACCEPTED_GATE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
841:     if _run_git(repo, "cat-file", "-e", f"{commit}^{{commit}}").returncode != 0:
842:         return None, _blocked("GATE_COMMIT_UNREACHABLE", commit=commit)
843:     if _run_git(repo, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", commit, "HEAD").returncode != 0:
844:         return None, _blocked("GATE_COMMIT_UNREACHABLE", commit=commit)
845:     for relative_path, expected_hash in sorted(files.items()):
846:         if (
847:             not isinstance(relative_path, str)
848:             or not isinstance(expected_hash, str)
849:             or not _is_safe_relative_path(relative_path)
850:             or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected_hash) is None
851:         ):
852:             return None, _blocked("ACCEPTED_GATE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
853:         committed = _run_git_bytes(repo, "show", f"{commit}:{relative_path}")
854:         if (
855:             committed.returncode != 0
856:             or _sha256_bytes(committed.stdout) != expected_hash
857:         ):
858:             return None, _blocked("GATE_FILE_HASH_MISMATCH", path=relative_path)
859:     if not _validate_acceptance_bindings(repo, manifest, trusted_resolver):
860:         return None, _blocked("ACCEPTED_GATE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
861:     return manifest, None
862:

864: def _validate_live_gate_files(
865:     repo: Path, files: Mapping[str, Any]
866: ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
867:     """Validates accepted gate files against current worktree bytes.
868: 
869:     @param repo Repository root.
870:     @param files Accepted path-to-hash mapping.
871:     @returns A hash-mismatch blocker, or ``None`` when all bytes match.
872:     """
873:     for relative_path, expected_hash in sorted(files.items()):
874:         live_path = repo / relative_path
875:         if (
876:             not _is_regular_repo_file(repo, relative_path)
877:             or _sha256_bytes(live_path.read_bytes()) != expected_hash
878:         ):
879:             return _blocked("GATE_FILE_HASH_MISMATCH", path=relative_path)
880:     return None

883: def _validate_plan(plan_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
884:     """Rejects hidden legacy work and non-structured incomplete tasks.
885: 
886:     @param plan_path Product track plan.
887:     @returns A blocker, or ``None`` when completion markers are valid.
888:     """
889:     try:
890:         text = plan_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
GATE_TRACK = "measure_apk_evidence_integrity_gates_20260712"
OWNER_DELEGATION_TEXT = (
    "For this project, YOU are the orchestrator, therefore YOU are acting as the owner."
)


class FixtureTrustedResolver:
    """Resolves test sessions from an explicit trusted-export mapping."""

    def __init__(self, exports: dict[str, bytes]) -> None:
        """Creates a resolver over immutable fixture exports.

        @param exports Session IDs mapped to trusted provider bytes.
        """
        self.exports = dict(exports)

    def resolve(self, session_id: str) -> bytes:
        """Returns trusted export bytes for a named fixture session.

        @param session_id Session to resolve.
        @returns Exact trusted provider export bytes.
        @throws RuntimeError When the session is unavailable.
        """
        if session_id not in self.exports:
            raise RuntimeError("trusted session unavailable")
        return self.exports[session_id]


class SupervisorIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Runs the public gate and supervisor adapters against isolated Git repositories."""

    maxDiff = None

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        """Creates a minimal protected product track with a valid accepted gate pin."""
        self.temporary_directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.repo = Path(self.temporary_directory.name)
        (self.repo / "measure" / "tracks" / "product_track").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.repo / "measure" / "tracks" / GATE_TRACK).mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.repo / "measure" / "generated").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.repo / "measure" / "evidence_integrity_gates").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.repo / "tests").mkdir()
        shutil.copy(REPO_ROOT / "measure" / "automation-supervisor.py", self.repo / "measure" / "automation-supervisor.py")
        for source in (REPO_ROOT / "measure" / "evidence_integrity_gates").glob("*.py"):
            shutil.copy(source, self.repo / "measure" / "evidence_integrity_gates" / source.name)
        self._write("measure/tracks.md", "# Tracks\n\n- product_track\n- measure_apk_evidence_integrity_gates_20260712\n\n## Archived Tracks\n")
        self._write("measure/anti-patterns.md", "# Catalog\n\n## A1 — control\n\n**Guard:** `tests/guard.sh`.\n")
        self._write("tests/guard.sh", "#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexit 0\n")
        self._write("measure/tracks/product_track/plan.md", "# Plan\n\n## Phase 1\n\n- [x] Task: done 1234567\n")
        self._write("measure/tracks/measure_apk_evidence_integrity_gates_20260712/plan.md", "# Plan\n\n## Phase 4\n\n- [b] Task: owner acceptance deferred:product-owner\n")
        self._write("measure/gate.py", "GATE = 1\n")
        self._write_bytes("measure/gate.bin", b"\xff\x00gate\n")
        self._git("init", "-q")
        self._git("config", "user.email", "test@example.com")
        self._git("config", "user.name", "Test")
        self._git("add", ".")
        self._git("commit", "-qm", "gate implementation")
        gate_commit = self._git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
        gate_paths = ["measure/automation-supervisor.py", "measure/gate.py", "measure/gate.bin"]
        gate_paths.extend(
            str(path.relative_to(self.repo))
            for path in sorted((self.repo / "measure/evidence_integrity_gates").glob("*.py"))

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        """Removes the isolated repository."""
        self.temporary_directory.cleanup()

    def _write(self, relative_path: str, content: str) -> None:
        """Writes one fixture file below the isolated repository."""
        path = self.repo / relative_path
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

    def _write_bytes(self, relative_path: str, content: bytes) -> None:
        """Writes exact fixture bytes below the isolated repository."""
        path = self.repo / relative_path
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(content)

    def _git(self, *arguments: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
        """Runs Git in the isolated repository and requires success."""
        return subprocess.run(["git", *arguments], cwd=self.repo, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)

    def _sha(self, path: Path) -> str:
        """Hashes one fixture file."""
        return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

    def _sha_bytes(self, content: bytes) -> str:
        """Hashes exact fixture bytes."""
        return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()

    def _write_export(self, raw: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """Writes one deterministic content-addressed compressed raw export."""
        raw_hash = self._sha_bytes(raw)
        relative_path = f"measure/acceptance/test/exports/{raw_hash}.json.gz"
        self._write_bytes(relative_path, gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0))
        return relative_path, raw_hash

    def _bind_review_export(self, review: dict[str, Any], raw: bytes) -> None:
        """Binds matching retained and trusted reviewer exports for a mutation test.

        @param review Review report whose provenance references the retained export.
        @param raw Exact mutated provider export bytes.
        @returns Nothing.
        """
        export_path, raw_hash = self._write_export(raw)
        provenance = review["fresh_context_provenance"]
        provenance["raw_export_path"] = export_path
        provenance["raw_export_sha256"] = raw_hash
        provenance["stored_export_sha256"] = self._sha(self.repo / export_path)
        self.trusted_exports[provenance["session_id"]] = raw

    def _raw_export(
        self,
        *,
        session_id: str,
        parent_session_id: str,
        agent: str,
        prompt_id: str,
        prompt: str,
        prompt_created_ms: int,
        final_id: str,
        final_text: str,
        completed_ms: int,
    ) -> bytes:
        """Builds a minimal provider export with exact IDs, text, and chronology."""
        return json.dumps({
            "info": {"id": session_id, "parentID": parent_session_id, "agent": agent},
            "messages": [
                {
                    "info": {"id": prompt_id, "sessionID": session_id, "role": "user", "time": {"created": prompt_created_ms}},
                    "parts": [{"type": "text", "text": prompt}],
                },
                {
                    "info": {
                        "id": final_id,
                        "sessionID": session_id,
                        "parentID": prompt_id,
                        "role": "assistant",
                        "agent": agent,
                        "time": {"created": prompt_created_ms + 1, "completed": completed_ms},
                    },
                    "parts": [{"type": "text", "text": final_text}],
                },
            ],
        }, sort_keys=True).encode()

    def _root_export(self, delegated_prompt: str) -> bytes:
        """Builds root owner-designation and approval-publication evidence."""
        return json.dumps({
            "info": {"id": "ses_root", "agent": "root-agent"},
            "messages": [
                {
                    "info": {"id": "msg_owner_designation", "sessionID": "ses_root", "role": "user", "time": {"created": 10}},
                    "parts": [{"type": "text", "text": OWNER_DELEGATION_TEXT}],
                },
                {
                    "info": {
                        "id": "msg_publication", "sessionID": "ses_root", "parentID": "msg_owner_designation",
                        "role": "assistant", "agent": "root-agent", "time": {"created": 40, "completed": 41},
                    },
                    "parts": [{
                        "type": "tool", "tool": "task", "callID": "call_approval",
                        "state": {
                            "status": "completed",
                            "input": {"prompt": delegated_prompt},
                            "metadata": {"sessionId": "ses_approval", "parentSessionId": "ses_root"},
                        },
                    }],
                },
            ],
        }, sort_keys=True).encode()

    def _write_generated_facts(self) -> None:
        """Writes generated facts bound to the current source revision."""
        revision = self._git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
        self._write(
            "measure/generated/architecture.json",
            json.dumps({"schemaVersion": "measure.architecture.v1", "sourceRevision": revision}) + "\n",
        )

    def _run_gate(self) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], dict[str, Any]]:
        """Runs the completion gate with an explicit trusted session resolver."""
        report = validate_supervisor_completion(

            "product_track",

        )
        result = SimpleNamespace(returncode=0 if report["ok"] else 1, stderr="")

        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stderr)

            self.repo,

        )

        self.assertEqual(report["blockers"][0]["code"], "ACCEPTED_GATE_MANIFEST_INVALID")

    def test_019_owner_label_cannot_replace_exact_delegation_contract(self) -> None:
        """Rejects matching retained/live owner labels that omit the exact owner contract."""
        manifest = json.loads(
            (self.repo / "measure/evidence-integrity-accepted-gate.json").read_text()
        )
        approval = json.loads((self.repo / manifest["owner_approval_path"]).read_text())
        weak_text = "YOU are acting as the owner."
        root = json.loads(self.trusted_exports["ses_root"])
        root["messages"][0]["parts"][0]["text"] = weak_text
        weak_raw = json.dumps(root, sort_keys=True).encode()
        weak_path, weak_hash = self._write_export(weak_raw)
        delegation = approval["root_owner_delegation"]
        delegation["raw_export_path"] = weak_path
        delegation["raw_export_sha256"] = weak_hash
        delegation["stored_export_sha256"] = self._sha(self.repo / weak_path)

            weak_text.encode()

        """Rejects retained reviewer exports that omit trusted live pre-prompt turns."""

            (self.repo / "measure/evidence-integrity-accepted-gate.json").read_text()
        )
        candidate = json.loads((self.repo / manifest["candidate_manifest_path"]).read_text())
